# SJF4J (Simple JSON Facade for Java)

> A unified structural processing layer built on JSON semantics. SJF4J processes native Java object graphs using consistent APIs for binding, navigation, validation, mapping, and patching.

- Website: https://sjf4j.org/
- Source code: https://github.com/sjf4j-projects/sjf4j
- Getting Started: https://sjf4j.org/docs/getting-started

## Key documentation

- Installation: https://sjf4j.org/docs/installation
- OBNT (Object-Based Node Tree): https://sjf4j.org/docs/modeling
- Compiled APIs: https://sjf4j.org/docs/compiled
- Binding: https://sjf4j.org/docs/binding
- Navigation (JSONPath / JSON Pointer): https://sjf4j.org/docs/navigating
- JSON Schema Validation: https://sjf4j.org/docs/validating
- Object Mapping: https://sjf4j.org/docs/mapping
- JDBC Result Mapping: https://sjf4j.org/docs/jdbc-mapping
- JSON Patching: https://sjf4j.org/docs/patching
- Backends & Formats: https://sjf4j.org/docs/backends
- External Nodes: https://sjf4j.org/docs/external-nodes
- Benchmarks: https://sjf4j.org/docs/benchmarks
- FAQ: https://sjf4j.org/docs/faq
